entities.summary: Artur Bodanzky was an Austrian-American conductor particularly associated with the operas of Wagner. He conducted Enrico Caruso's last performance at the Metropolitan Opera House on Christmas Eve 1920. Artur Bodanzky was a composers & musicians from Vienna (1877-12-16, Vienna–1939-11-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
